The '''Ember Rod''' is an unobtainable {{Epic}} [[Swords|Sword]] which used to be dropped by the [[Magma Cube Boss (Old)|Magma Cube Boss]] in the [[Blazing Fortress]]. It requires {{Skill|Combat|8}} to use and can now only be obtained through the [[Auction House]] or [[Trading]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Ember Rod''' is unobtainable. Prior to the 0.7.8 update, the '''Ember Rod''' would drop to a random player: you must have dealt at least {{Red|1}} damage to roll for an '''Ember Rod'''. Only one player could obtain an '''Ember Rod''' per boss.

== Trivia ==
* The Ember Rod is directly related to another Hypixel Minigame, Mega Walls. The ability of the Blaze Kit in Mega Walls is the same as the Ember Rod.
* Upon SkyBlock's initial release, the '''Ember Rod''' was considered to be one of the best swords in the game, falling behind the {{Item|Leaping Sword}} and {{Item|Pigman Sword}} and costing over {{C|200k}} on the Auction House.
**{{RN|YouTube|TimeDeo}} and his [[Co-op]] members abused the high cost of the '''Ember Rod''' and the fact that the Magma Cube Boss's spawn times used to vary between servers to become the first Co-op with {{C|50m}}.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ZSygjOBES8&t=104s</ref>
* The '''Ember Rod''' could previously be crafted into {{Item|Blaze Powder}} using the vanilla crafting grid in the [[Inventory]]. A later update forbade non-vanilla items from being used in vanilla crafting recipes.
* The {{AN|Fire Blast}} ability doesn't work on {{MobSprite|Enderman|alt=Endermen}}, as projectiles cannot hit them.
